verdict:
A hundred and some repos and half of them have no description, which is how you end up with a junkyard where even the owner has to read the tags. Judging by names alone, this fleet is a cloning plant. There are four different towns that are clearly the same pixel town (topdown-pixeltown, topdown-pixeltowns, pixelmill, pixelcoop-farm), a whole litter of topo-war variants, three field-twin repos that differ by color name like paint swatches, two tower games, and a stack of audio visualizers wearing different hats. Then there are the repos called xxxx, x, rat, and androids, which tell me nothing except that naming things was somebody else's job. Plenty of this looks dropped halfway through, and the bulk-touched push dates do not fool me.

Merge these: topo-wars, topo-war, and topo-wars-server into one game with a server folder. topdown-pixeltown and topdown-pixeltowns into one repo. tower-builder and tower2 into one app with a version switch. field-twin, field-twin-viridian, and field-twin-violet-api into one twin with a theme setting. termbeat, coffeekit, bitfield-synth, spectral-engine, and scope-listener into one audio visualizer with a mode switch. The signal-snapshot pair, the hackercons-roulette pair, and the skwiggle repos each into one repo with a backend folder. threat-poller, threat-dash, and threat-atlas-v3 into one threat app.

Kill or finish these: xxxx, x, rat, androids, ascend, note-note-note, pancake-orange, drivethru-sim, and anything else with no description and no push since mid September. Either write one sentence saying what it is or archive it. Also finish skwiggle-v105, which is described as replaced by a host stumbler, so delete the corpse or the stumbler.

Keep and polish these: nota-city for the shared city idea with a real tick engine, groundcore for a planting planner that solves an actual problem, graceland-diagram for the 3D shed build, shitty-ass-trading-app once it gets a better name, mission-operator for the scanner console, edmia for the music-per-move hook, and the contracts signer that fingerprints agreements on chain, since nobody else in this pile is doing anything that odd.
